_comment: Zero-environment runtime census, per registered datrix.languages package.
Every language entry carries a 'kind'. reviewed_exemptions: every template
that reads the environment is listed with a written reason (hand-authored;
an unlisted read and a stale entry both fail). pinned_count: a decrease-only
count of environment-reading templates, for a language that delivers runtime
facts through the environment by design; only -UpdateBaseline writes it, and
never upward. A language with no entry is held to reviewed_exemptions with an

exemptions.reason: The Cognito user-pool id is an app setting the AWS deployment delivers; read once at import via os.environ[...] and fails loud (KeyError) when absent.
The Entra extension-property prefix is a deploy-time app setting the ARM deployment delivers; read once at import and fails loud when absent.
The machine-identity audience GUID is an ARM deployment output delivered as an app setting; _machine_identity_audience raises RuntimeError when it is unset or empty.
allowedAudienceRefs name deploy-time app settings that hold audience values; an unset ref raises JwksValidationError, never an empty audience.
Pooled-Redis env-var slice delivery, selected only when the resolved platform's cache_pooled_slice_delivery capability declares env-var; the non-pooled path reads AppSettings.
The container-platform serverless HTTP entrypoint binds the port the compose runtime injects as PORT; fails loud (KeyError) when absent.
_require_env reads trusted-caller and shared-UAI Redis app settings delivered as ARM outputs on Azure and raises when a required one is missing; emitted only when those features are declared.
